title: Metabolic Effects of Acute Cortisol Withdrawal in Adrenal Failure
brief_summary: Effects of adrenal steroids is generelly drawn from studies of hypercortisolism. The effects of physiological cortisol substitution and withdrawal is studied and related to the clinical syndrome of adrenal insufficiency.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Female adrenal failure
* Age 18-50
* Written informed content

Exclusion Criteria:

* Diabetes mellitus
* Cancer
* Thromboembolic events
* Pregnancy and lactation
* Heart disease
